origin: Original deterministic synthetic images; no downloaded or third-party media.

tools.imagemagick: Version: ImageMagick 7.1.2-35 Q16-HDRI x86_64 acaf7e418:20261031 https://imagemagick.org
tools.raster_source: 64px square random-color checkerboard; seeded per-block RGB; alternating dark/bright cells; optional 8px/128px blocks

notes: Fixtures are inputs, not performance results.
Application compatibility has not been measured; do not assume generated means supported.
Large WebP is omitted; this set targets large JPEG/PNG/BMP/TIFF.
All raster inputs are random-color checkerboards, with fixed block seed 20261108. Default block size is 64 pixels; variants explicitly state another size.
Source patterns are synthetic and do not cover the complete entropy distribution of photographs.
Large TIFF files are single-page, non-pyramidal; Classic TIFF and BigTIFF containers are explicit.
Image generation and verification warm file caches. Prepare the required cache state before performance measurement.
